facts.fact: ITWeb reports President Mnangagwa launched the five-year National AI Strategy (2026-2030) in Harare on Friday, the Friday before the 16 March 2026 article.

ITWeb reports the AI Strategy Implementation Office, based in the Ministry of ICT, is responsible for driving AI projects under the strategy, with a National digital Regulatory Committee under POTRAZ as regulatory custodian.
